## Description

Trades relative richness of downside versus upside implied volatility using risk-reversals, put spreads or delta-hedged options.

## Where it may fit

Persistent demand for downside protection or dislocations in the implied-volatility smile; risk premiums can widen sharply in selloffs.

## Vehicles

Volatility-arbitrage, options market-making and tail-risk funds.

## Required data

Option chain by strike/expiry, implied vol, Greeks, underlying prices, rates/dividends, realized vol and bid/ask quotes.

## Caveats

Skew is not a direction-neutral free premium; crash convexity, jumps, hedging frequency and liquidity can cause losses.
